Heap-buffer-overflow in OpenEXR's DWA decompression: readUInt in internal_huf.c performs an out-of-bounds 4-byte read during Huffman decompression (internal_huf_decompress) invoked by the DWA compressor (DwaCompressor_uncompress / internal_exr_undo_dwaa).
